_source: The 'Create a webhook' response example at https://developer.woocommerce.com/docs/apis/rest-api/v3/webhooks#create-a-webhook (id 142, topic order.updated), with name and delivery_url set to what GoPayLocal sends. The docs example's hooks list is kept as published; WooCommerce 11.3.0 maps order.updated to woocommerce_update_order, woocommerce_order_refunded and woocommerce_order_refund_deleted (class-wc-webhook.php get_default_topic_hooks). The secret is write-only and not returned.
name: GoPayLocal redemptions (order.updated)
